commits.message:
feat(history): add programmatic undo-group control

Add groupUndo(view, fn) API that collapses all editor changes made
inside the callback into a single undo step — one Ctrl+Z reverts
the entire group.

- StateField<number> undoGroupDepth tracks active nesting
- startUndoGroup / endUndoGroup StateEffects manage depth
- history() joinToEvent forces transaction joining when depth > 0
- isolateHistory annotations isolate the group from surrounding edits
- Supports nested groupUndo calls (outermost boundary defines step)
- Callback errors are handled: group closes properly in finally block
- Re-exports undo/redo/undoDepth/redoDepth from @codemirror/commands

Roadmap: #8 (P1)
No OpenSpec required per docs/ROADMAP.md

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
